rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE f.Balance < 0

description: DateSK (fact) must be >= DimSavingsAccount.AccountOpenDate when AccountOpenDate is populated, and must be <= DimSavingsAccount.AccountCloseDate when AccountCloseDate is populated.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE (d.AccountOpenDate IS NOT NULL AND f.DateSK < CONVERT(int, CONVERT(varchar(8), d.AccountOpenDate, 112))) OR (d.AccountCloseDate IS NOT NULL AND f.DateSK > CONVERT(int, CONVERT(varchar(8), d.AccountCloseDate, 112)))

description: AccountNumber in the fact table must match the AccountNumber in the linked DimSavingsAccount row.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE ISNULL(f.AccountNumber,'') <> ISNULL(d.AccountNumber,'')

description: When the linked DimSavingsAccount.ProductCode = 'FIXED_1Y', the DimSavingsAccount.AccountMaturityDate must be populated.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE d.ProductCode = 'FIXED_1Y' AND d.AccountMaturityDate IS NULL

description: When the linked DimSavingsAccount.AccountStatus = 'CLOSED', DimSavingsAccount.AccountCloseDate must be populated and AccountCloseDate must be >= AccountOpenDate.
rule_sql: SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE d.AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' AND (d.AccountCloseDate IS NULL OR d.AccountOpenDate IS NULL OR d.AccountCloseDate < d.AccountOpenDate)
SELECT f.* FROM pres.FactSavingsAccount f JOIN pres.DimSavingsAccount d ON f.SavingsAccountSK = d.SavingsAccountSK WHERE ISNULL(d.Currency,'') <> 'GBP'
